finish.text: Another important part of your brain is the cerebrum. The cerebrum controls your movement, memory, emotions and how you perceive the world. It is the command center of your body.

atoms.a: Besides what you’ve already learnt, what else does your brain do?

trainers.instruction: Look at the image and answer the question.

atoms.a: The circled area is the cerebrum. Is it smaller or larger than the cerebellum?

end.text: The cerebrum is larger than the cerebellum and makes up over 80% of your total brain mass!

instruction.text: Drag each description to the correct picture to learn more about what the cerebrum does.

feedback.finish: Thinking, problem-solving, feeling emotions and remembering are all things your cerebrum is responsible for.
